title: An Efficient and Perfect Secret Sharing Scheme on a Class of Non-Maximal Quantum Access Structure
summary: Quantum secret sharing is one of the core security technologies in the field of quantum communication. Aiming at the problems of high quantum resource consumption and the difficulty in balancing security and efficiency existing in current quantum secret sharing schemes under non-maximal quantum access structure(QAS), this paper focuses on the judgment criteria of non-maximal QAS and the construction methods of efficient and perfect quantum secret sharing schemes on a kind of non-maximal QAS, i.e. hyperstar with three hyperedges.
